text:
sarah: Heads-up — ap-south GPU warm pool started failing healthchecks ~10m ago, can't finish bootstrap for ~8 nodes. Instance provisioning keeps retrying.
ton y: seeing that too. metrics: node-ready dropping, warm-pool utilization spiking. Any recent infra changes?
sarah: only thing I can find in audit logs is a firewall policy change from last deploy. looks like egress to our keystore proxy was restricted.
ritesh: that was my change — we tightened outbound to keystore IPs to comply with new customer audit. did we forget the proxy subnet range?
olivia: oh. which rule specifically? I can roll back if needed.
ritesh: updated sg-egress-ap-south to only allow x.y.10.0/24 and x.y.11.15/32, but the keystore proxies are served from x.y.12.0/24 in that region. my bad.
sarah: stack traces from the node bootstrap:

```
2026-03-20T12:02:31Z systemd[1]: Starting node-bootstrap.service...
2026-03-20T12:02:33Z node-bootstrap[2345]: failed to fetch /secrets/bootstrap: connection timeout
2026-03-20T12:02:33Z node-bootstrap[2345]: KMS decrypt error: 403 AccessDenied
```

keystore-bot: alert — 403s to keystore proxy increased by 420% in ap-south since 12:00Z. sample request IDs: req-3a7f, req-3a80
tony: looks like nodes can't decrypt instance secrets -> services fail -> node never joins cluster. that's why warm pool is stuck.
olivia: rolling the sg rule back now. will add the missing CIDR.
ritesh: thanks, please coordinate with @sarah to uncordon affected warm-nodes after rollback.
infra-bot: deploy started: rolling sg change (id: sg-rollback-372). ETA ~45s.
olivia: rollback applied. can someone confirm keystore 200s/responses?
keystore-bot: keystore latency back to baseline in ap-south; 200s resumed. audit log sample: "Decrypt succeeded" for req-3a7f
sarah: starting manual warm-pool reconcile. hoping nodes join.
tony: FYI this triggered a cross-region fallback for ~12 requests which routed to eu-west and incurred ~$120 extra in egress transfer over the hour.
ritesh: noted. we should add a CI check that prevents overly strict egress rules to keystore ranges and include canary IPs in the change checklist.
olivia: creating follow-up ticket in infra: "egress-rule-canary-and-guardrails" and adding a postmortem note in #postmortems.
tony: also propose: (1) add unit tests for sg templates to validate keystore CIDRs, (2) alert on node-bootstrap KMS 403 spike >5% for >2m, and (3) a safety allowlist for warm-pool subnets during rollout.
sarah: agree. I'll draft the alert rules and a short runbook for this scenario.
ritesh: apologies for the slip — will coordinate changes with infra runbook from now on.
olivia: no drama — good catch by the monitoring.
infra-bot: warm-pool reconcile completed: 8 nodes Ready, cluster capacity restored.
sarah: closing incident — will add timeline + remediation to ticket. :white_check_mark:
